title: Popups
tagline: Ready-to-use popups and dialogs for abap2UI5 apps, one factory( ) call each.
summary: popups is a library of finished dialog classes for abap2UI5 apps: confirm, inform, select from a list, decide, get values, edit a text, upload and download files, show a table, a PDF, HTML or messages, pick a range, a value help or a search help. Each popup is an abap2UI5 app of its own that you call with client->nav_app_call( ) and that hands its result back as an event you name or through its result( ) method. The classes were moved here from the abap2UI5 core framework. Use it when you need standard dialogs without writing views, or as counterparts for POPUP_TO_CONFIRM, POPUP_TO_INFORM and CL_DEMO_OUTPUT when moving classic code.
features: Confirm, Inform, Select, Decide and Get Values popups
File upload and download, including binary and multiple files
Table, data and CL_DEMO_OUTPUT style output popups
Text editor, HTML and PDF display; messages, error and input validation
Range selection, value help and search help popups
A sample app for every popup (z2ui5_cl_popup_sample_*)
requirements: abap2UI5-addons/layout-management (current version, pulled together with this repository)
ABAP Cloud (S/4 Public Cloud, BTP ABAP Environment), S/4 Private Cloud or On-Premise, or NetWeaver 7.50 or higher
Transports only on On-Premise; search help not yet on the Cloud stack

notes: Install with abapGit in this order: 1. abap2UI5, 2. layout-management, 3. this repository from the branch that fits your system
Branch main for ABAP Cloud, S/4HANA and NetWeaver 7.50 or higher; branch 702 for NetWeaver 7.02 - 7.40 (pull layout-management from 702 as well)
Start a sample like any abap2UI5 app, e.g. ?app_start=z2ui5_cl_popup_sample_05

usage:
METHOD z2ui5_if_app~main.

  IF client->check_on_event( `DELETE` ).
    client->nav_app_call( z2ui5_cl_popup_to_confirm=>factory(
        i_question_text = `Delete the entry?`
        i_event_confirm = `DELETE_CONFIRMED`
        i_event_cancel  = `DELETE_CANCELED` ) ).

  ELSEIF client->check_on_event( `DELETE_CONFIRMED` ).
    client->message_box_display( `Entry deleted` ).

  ELSEIF client->check_on_event( `DELETE_CANCELED` ).
    client->message_box_display( `Nothing changed` ).

  ENDIF.

ENDMETHOD.
